description: This file defines React components for a UI sheet/modal, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling utilities.

methods.name: Sheet
methods.description: Main component rendering the root of the sheet using Radix UI's Root primitive.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component to trigger opening the sheet, based on Radix UI's Trigger primitive.

methods.name: SheetClose
methods.description: Component to close the sheet, based on Radix UI's Close primitive.

methods.name: SheetPortal
methods.description: Component rendering the portal for the sheet content.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation for the sheet background.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Component for the main content of the sheet, with configurable side position.

methods.name: SheetHeader
methods.description: Component for the sheet header section.

methods.name: SheetFooter
methods.description: Component for the sheet footer section.
